"""Run after the selector serving pair ends; builds only, no GPU execution."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--assets', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--arm', choices=['generic', 'configured', 'pruned'], required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
repo = Path.cwd()
assert os.environ.get('IN_NIX_SHELL')
assert (a.assets / 'plow_config.h').is_file()
a.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'scripts'))
import plow_isa

stem = 'interp_decode_fp8kv_gq'
axes = json.loads(Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-fp8-b20/decode-objects/build_defines.json').read_text())[stem]
args = [os.environ['PLOW_HIPCC'], '--offload-arch=gfx942', '-O3', '-w', *shlex.split(axes)]
if a.arm != 'generic':
    args += [f'-I{a.assets.resolve()}', '-DPLOW_CONFIG="plow_config.h"', f'-DPLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE={int(a.arm == "pruned")}']
args += ['--genco', str(repo / 'runtime/amd/interp.hip'), '-o', str(a.out / (stem + '.co')),
         '-I' + str(repo / 'runtime/amd'), '-I' + str(repo / 'runtime/common')]
with (a.out / 'build.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(args, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
image = a.out / (stem + '.elf')
subprocess.run([os.environ['PLOW_BUNDLER'], '--unbundle', '--type=o', '--targets=hipv4-amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx942',
                '--input=' + str(a.out / (stem + '.co')), '--output=' + str(image)], check=True)
record = {'arm': a.arm, 'command': args, 'image_sha256': hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'header_sha256': hashlib.sha256((a.assets / 'plow_config.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'notes': plow_isa.notes(image), 'globals': plow_isa.globals_u32(image)}
(a.out / 'build-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'arm': a.arm, 'notes': record['notes']}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-prune
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on off; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay-$arm"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets" --port 18993 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18993/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18993 "glm-pruning-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18993 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done

diff --git a/runtime/amd/interp.hip b/runtime/amd/interp.hip
index bde9c89c..6557dd48 100644
--- a/runtime/amd/interp.hip
+++ b/runtime/amd/interp.hip
@@ -4126,19 +4126,25 @@ __device__ static void plow_exec(CInst in_v, unsigned slice, CTens T_v, plow_sme
          * lm_head (PLOW_FP8_HEAD off), and a bf16-weight/fp8-KV program emits GEMV_GLU and
          * GEMV_QKV — which this object used to drop. Measured: 248/0/occ 2/spill 0 with the bf16
          * arms back, IDENTICAL to without them. */
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_GEMV_FP8
         case PLOW_DOP_GEMV_FP8:
             exec_gemv_fp8(in, T, slice, nblk, sm->gm);
             break;
+#endif
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_GEMV_GLU_FP8
         case PLOW_DOP_GEMV_GLU_FP8:
             exec_gemv_glu_fp8(in, T, slice, nblk, sm->gm);
             break;
+#endif
         /* FUSED Q|K|V, per-channel fp8 — op 22's twin, sharing op 30's body (that one is this with
          * Nk=Nv=0). The three f32 scale rows are handles in i5/i6/i7; the arm TRAPS on a malformed
          * packet rather than running a narrower sweep, because `default:` here writes nothing. */
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_GEMV_QKV_FP8
         case PLOW_DOP_GEMV_QKV_FP8:
             exec_gemv_qkv_fp8(in, T, slice, nblk, sm->gm);
             break;
 #endif
+#endif
 #if PLOW_MXFP4
         case PLOW_DOP_GEMV_MXFP4:
             exec_gemv_mxfp4(in, T, slice, nblk, sm->gm);
@@ -4202,9 +4208,11 @@ __device__ static void plow_exec(CInst in_v, unsigned slice, CTens T_v, plow_sme
 #if PLOW_FP8_KV
         /* fp8-KV decode object: SWAP in the fp8 flash so the bf16 flash_decode is not compiled and
          * the register budget stays flat against the 256/occ-2 cliff. */
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_FLASH_DECODE_FP8
         case PLOW_DOP_FLASH_DECODE_FP8:
             exec_flash_decode_fp8(in, T, slice, nblk, sm->fd);
             break;
+#endif
 #else
 #if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_FLASH_DECODE
         case PLOW_DOP_FLASH_DECODE:
@@ -4229,12 +4237,16 @@ __device__ static void plow_exec(CInst in_v, unsigned slice, CTens T_v, plow_sme
          * REAL arm instead of the silent-NOP `default:`. The cost is that the bf16 instantiation
          * is still in this object, so the swap buys no register headroom for MLA — it buys the
          * halved KV, which is the point. */
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_FLASH_MLA_DECODE_FP8
         case PLOW_DOP_FLASH_MLA_DECODE_FP8:
             exec_flash_mla_decode_fp8(in, T, slice, nblk, PLOW_FMLA(sm));
             break;
+#endif
+#if !PLOW_DECODE_INVENTORY_PRUNE || PLOW_HAS_FLASH_GATHER_DECODE
         case PLOW_DOP_FLASH_GATHER_DECODE:
             exec_flash_mla_decode(in, T, slice, nblk, PLOW_FMLA(sm));
             break;
+#endif
 #else
